source.note: The source commit pins API implementation, not the mutable live catalog. This file is the dated catalog observation.

selectionPolicy: 30 distinct exercises chosen for a bounded real-motion pilot. One source object per exercise; direct MP4/H.264 first, then H.264, then smallest object. Exercise variety was selected manually from the 46 live wger exercises with video. No existing Rafik exercise mapping is asserted.
requiredAttribution: Video by Goulart via wger, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Link the license and the wger object/exercise record; record any remux, transcode, crop, trim, poster extraction, or other modification.
distributionCaveat: CC BY-SA 4.0 forbids added effective technological measures that restrict exercise of the licensed rights. Keep an unencumbered copy of each asset/derivative available with attribution and license information rather than relying only on a DRM-constrained app bundle.
acquisitionRule: Fetch the exact sourceMediaUrl, verify returned content metadata, compute and store SHA-256, then transcode/remux to MP4/H.264 where required. This research manifest records API metadata, not file hashes; it did not download the 928,398,681-byte selected pack.
